doc.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025

chapter: Jazz players and the record industry
title: John Dorn and Leon Redbone
summary: Gold knew Joel Dorn's brother John, a tuba player, who played with Leon Redbone.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Do you know Joel Dorn? Did you know Joel Dorn?
I grew up with his brother, John Dorn, who was a tuba player. And then John I think went to Curtis too for a little while and then John Dorn ended up playing with Leon Redbone. Remember Leon Redbone?
Remember he had a tuba player and a banjo player?

Joel's brother John played tuba for Leon. But I met John in the '80s through somebody else that I was making records for. And then he died shortly thereafter so I really didn't know him that well but I met him quite a few times during the '80s.
